title: Vision System — Visual Perception
summary: Turns every camera frame into a structured Observation that improves the World Model. Transport moves frames; a modular processing pipeline perceives; the Observation Builder standardizes; the Cognitive Bridge routes observations through Attention -> Perception -> Entity Resolver -> World Model (never bypassing it); the Scene Graph and Visual Memory retain what was seen. Vision is a perception subsystem only — it performs no reasoning.
pipeline: Reality -> Camera -> Vision Transport -> Camera Manager -> Frame -> Processing Pipeline -> Observation Builder -> Attention -> Entity Resolver -> Persistent Entity IDs -> World Model -> Knowledge Graph -> Memory -> Reasoning -> Executive -> Planner -> Prediction -> Simulation -> Action -> Reality
must_never: write the World Model directly from a processor
block transport/socket threads with AI work
crash the Cognitive Core on a vision failure

transport.role: move frames into the COS as Frame objects via the Camera Manager (M14 part 1; productionized Flask+SocketIO+OpenCV)

processing.role: modular processor plugins: scene_stats, motion, segmentation, tracking (always-available); objects, face, face_recognition, ocr, pose (opt-in, graceful)

observation.role: convert processing results into core.perception.Observation objects (the only place vision builds observations)

integration.role: Cognitive Bridge: Observation -> Attention -> Perception(ResolvingWorldFeed) -> Entity Resolver -> World Model; link scene objects to stable ids; emit visual events

scene.role: live per-camera Scene Graph: persistent objects, spatial relationships, camera/world positions, room hooks

memory.role: Visual Memory: significant observations, visual events, object histories, scene changes (SQLite)

service.role: VisionSystem facade composing all stages; processing runs on its own thread

mission_control.role: cockpit vision panel + on-demand live preview

outputs.name: SceneObject
outputs.id: tracker track id linked to permanent ENT_ stable id

optional_backends: cv2 (motion CC, face Haar, decode, dnn)

public_api: VisionSystem(config?, runtime?, perception?, cognition?, attention?, world_model?, transport?)
process_camera(camera_id) / process_all() / warmup() / start(warmup?) / stop() / close()

performance.rule: processing runs off transport threads and is throttled to max_processing_fps

reliability: corrupted frames (decoder returns None -> corrupt flag, never a crash)
server restart (persistent registry keeps camera ids)
invariants: every frame becomes a Frame, never a raw array downstream
only the Observation Builder creates Observations
observations never bypass entity resolution (routed via ResolvingWorldFeed)
no processor writes the World Model
processing never runs on a transport/socket thread
a vision failure can never crash the Cognitive Core
